create_dataset_instance: create a VisionTactileForceFieldDataset instance with a DictConfig and dataset name for tactile sensor data
get_dataset_item: get a single training item from the VisionTactileForceFieldDataset by index returning tactile images
load_tactile_images: load and process tactile images from a reference frame with configurable output format
configure_augmentations: configure data augmentation parameters like flip crop and rotation probabilities in the dataset config
visualize_tactile_clip: visualize a tactile clip by plotting frames as images and saving to a PNG file
